h1: Lifestyle & Amenities at Heart of Harmony - Hosur Road, Bengaluru

blocks.text: Heart of Harmony Location - Near Koramangala, HSR Layout & Silk Board
Can you imagine being minutes away from some of the city’s best dining, shopping and entertainment?
Seamless Connectivity — Hosur Main Road, Bengaluru

Heart of Harmony, right on Hosur Main Road, just 10 minutes from Silk Board, is at the center of Bengaluru’s most vibrant lifestyle hubs, with Koramangala, HSR Layout, and BTM Layout, Electronic City close by.
You can live in a neighbourhood where everyday life is convenient, making work, leisure, and entertainment easily accessible.
Metro Access — 400 Metres from Kudlu Gate Station
Heart of Harmony's location at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road puts the Yellow Line metro 400 metres from your door — the fastest way across South Bengaluru without driving
Amenities at Heart of Harmony - Outdoor & Clubhouse Facilities
Amenities at Heart of Harmony are thoughtfully placed across two levels, bringing together wellness, recreation, and social living, creating a richer everyday lifestyle for every resident.
Heart of Harmony Clubhouse Wellness & Leisure Above the City
Set against panoramic skyline views, the rooftop clubhouse offers a private retreat dedicated to wellness and relaxation.
Swimming pool with paddle pool & lazy pool
Frequently Asked Questions — Heart of Harmony

items.q: What amenities are available at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony offers 40+ amenities across two levels: Heart of Harmony’s outdoor amenities (basketball court, outdoor gym, pickleball, jogging track, bicycle track, rock climbing wall, table tennis, tot lot) and Clubhouse ( sky deck pool with paddle and lazy pool, spa, sauna and steam, ice bath, gym, banquet hall with kitchen, co-working space, multipurpose activity room, indoor games).

items.q: Is there a swimming pool at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony has a sky deck swimming pool on the rooftop clubhouse level with a paddle pool and lazy pool. The pool offers panoramic views of South Bengaluru’s skyline. Learn more about all clubhouse amenities.

items.q: Does Heart of Harmony have a gym and spa?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony’s rooftop clubhouse includes a fully equipped gym, spa treatment rooms, sauna, steam room, and ice bath — hotel-standard wellness facilities for residents.

items.q: Are there outdoor sports facilities at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony’s outdoor amenities include a pickleball court, basketball practice court, outdoor gym, jogging track, bicycle track, rock climbing wall, multipurpose court, table tennis, and indoor games.

items.q: Heart of Harmony close to Koramangala and HSR Layout?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony is located on Hosur Main Road (NH48) at Kudlu Gate — approximately 15 minutes from Koramangala and 12 minutes from HSR Layout. The Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line) is 400 metres away.
